error.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.
error.AUTH_ERROR: An error occurred while signing in. Please try again.
error.DAILY_SIGNUP_LIMIT_REACHED: We've already taken all the new accounts we accept today. Please try again tomorrow.
error.DISPOSABLE_EMAIL: This address belongs to a temporary email service. Please use your usual email.
error.DOCUMENT_INVALID_FORMAT: The server didn't understand this document's format. Download it to your device so you don't lose it, and let us know.
error.DOCUMENT_SAVE_ERROR: The document couldn't be saved. Please try again.
error.EMAIL_INVALID_FORMAT: The email address format is not valid
error.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: You need to verify your email before saving to the cloud. Check your inbox.
error.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: One of the images is too heavy to save to the cloud. Add it again at a lower quality (Settings › User › Image quality).
error.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Your session was closed from another device. Sign in again to save to the cloud; your work hasn't been lost.
error.MAX_USERS_REACHED: We've reached the maximum number of accounts. Please try again later.
error.PASSWORD_MISSING_LOWERCASE: The password must contain at least one lowercase letter
error.PASSWORD_MISSING_NUMBER: The password must contain at least one number
error.PASSWORD_MISSING_UPPERCASE: The password must contain at least one uppercase letter
error.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 10 characters long
error.QUOTA_DOCUMENTS_EXCEEDED: You've reached the maximum number of saved documents. Delete one to save a new one.
error.QUOTA_STORAGE_EXCEEDED: You've reached your image storage limit. In Settings › User you can see what each image takes up and delete some.
error.QUOTA_WORD_PROFILES_EXCEEDED: You've reached the maximum number of personalised words. Delete one to add more.
error.REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Sign in again to save to the cloud; your work hasn't been lost.
error.REFRESH_TOKEN_MISSING: Your session was closed in this browser. Sign in again to save to the cloud; your work hasn't been lost.
error.REGISTER_ERROR: An error occurred while creating your account. Please try again.
error.REGISTRATION_CLOSED: Registrations are temporarily closed. Please try again later.
error.SET_PASSWORD_ERROR: There was an error setting the password. Please try again.
error.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
error.TOO_MANY_REGISTRATIONS: Too many accounts have been created from this connection. Please try again in a while.
error.UNKNOWN_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.USER_NOT_FOUND: This account no longer exists. Your work is still saved on this device: download it if you want a copy.
error.USE_CASE_REQUIRED: You need to choose how you'll use the app
error.VERIFICATION_EMAIL_FAILED: We couldn't send the verification email. Please try again in a while.
error.VERIFICATION_TOKEN_INVALID: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
